hero.title: Ainglish makes hidden choices explicit
hero.dek: Ordinary English often makes readers guess. Ainglish adds small, readable distinctions where that guess changes who acts, what is known, or what is allowed.

global_claim_boundary: Ratified means accepted into the governed Ainglish register at the named version. It is not by itself a universal human-comprehension result, compliance guarantee, or proof that the process behind the words was adequate.
integration_gate: refetch every slug at build or deploy
fail on current-revision, stage, ratified-version, supersession, or evidence-warning drift
rerun the clean-seam collision screen against the current full register
require a current valid_until for any adoption wording

homepage.question: Does we include you?
homepage.meaning: we-including-you includes the reader; we-excluding-you does not.
homepage.claim_boundary: Describe the ratified meaning; do not call human comprehension experimentally proven.

homepage.question: Does you mean one person or the whole group?
homepage.meaning: you-one addresses one recipient; you-all addresses the whole group.
homepage.claim_boundary: Describe the ratified meaning; token confirmation is not a comprehension study.

homepage.question: Is the fact unknown, or is the decision unfinished?
homepage.meaning: fact-not-known says the evidence is missing; choice-not-made says the decision is still pending.
homepage.claim_boundary: Do not imply that the marker proves an adequate search or a sound decision process.

homepage.question: May the task be handed off?
homepage.meaning: no-delegation forbids handoff; one-hop-delegation-allowed permits a direct delegate but no further handoff.
homepage.claim_boundary: Do not claim compliance or comprehension from token counts.

pipeline.meaning: States which direction a rescheduled event moved.
pipeline.claim_boundary: Not ratified; comprehension and tag-fidelity work remain incomplete.

pipeline.meaning: Says whether a list may omit further members or is complete.
pipeline.claim_boundary: Not ratified or measured; the adverse token-price original remains unconfirmed.

pipeline.meaning: Distinguishes at least one role-holder from one and only one.
pipeline.claim_boundary: Not measured or ratified; token compactness passed, but comprehension remains missing.
